tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// glo bo thub chen gyi gtsug lag khang dang*/ bkra shis sgo mangs sogs kyi dkar chag bzhugs// tshangs dbang gtsug gi zla gzhon lang tsho'i rtse// khyod zhabs nyin mor byed pa'i mdangs gsal gyis// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun chen sel mkhas pa// snang mdzad lha mi'i ston pas 'dir bsrungs shig /brtse chen yongs kyi 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i dpag bsam gyis// gang 'thungs srid zhi'i 'jug ngogs nyams dga' bar// phan mdzad 'jig rten dbang pos 'dir dgongs shig /bod 'bangs utpal skyong mdzad thugs rje'i gter// pad dkar 'dzin mdzad mtshan mo'i nyi ma ni// gangs can dbang po'i lam du shar gyur nas// phan bde'i lam bzang mtshon rnams thog mar dge /phyi ma'i dus su mi bdag phal cher yang*// 'jig rten khams kyi rin thang kun bzod pa// ji lta'i dpyad la sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis// rnam par rmongs pa'i lam du 'jug la 'gran// dus 'dir bsod nams brgya pa'i dge mtshan gyis// pha rol gnod dang rang srid skyong ba dang*// thub bstan ri mor bgyi ba'i mdzad pa yi// sa skyong rgyal por 'os pa bkra shis mtshan// gang 'di'i bgrang yas mdzad pa'i ri mo ni// phyogs bral skye bo'i snying gi me long la// nam yang 'char ba'i ltad mos kun dga' ba// phrag dog lag pas bsub par nus ma yin// thub chen 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i pho brang mchog /gzhan la med pa'i ya mtshan brgya phrag brgyas// mngon par chub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po// lha yi bzo bo las kun pas 'di byas// brgya byin gyis mchod mes po'i snying la yang*// zag med bde ster bu ram shing pa'i bka'// gangs can ljongs su ji snyed 'gyur de kun// ngo mtshar gser ri'i phreng ba gang 'dis bskrun// //bkra shis sgo brgya ldan pa'i mchod rten ni// gyen du 'degs pa'i khang bzang dge zhing mtho// steng nas 'gebs pa'i gdugs mdzes khor yug yangs// 'od 'bar nor bu'i tog gis dang ba 'dren// gang 'di mkha' las char chen mang bab pa// yid bzhin rgya mtshor dbye ba med de bzhin// yon tan kun gyi mdzod mnga' chos kyi sku// ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i bkra shis spyon// steng gi cha la rdo rje 'chang dbang nas// dbang gi chu chen nges par ma nub cing*// man ngag brgyud bzang nam yang ma chad pa'i// dam tshig slob dpon de kun rim par bzhugs// gang sku sku lnga'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*// de'i gsung gsung gi dbang phyug bdag med ma// nyid thugs thugs rje'i dbang phyug birwa pa'i// phrin las las chen rnam bzhi'i bkra shis spyon// dbus su chos dbyings ngo bo 'khor lo bsgyur// rgyal phran lta bu'i mi skyod la sogs bzhi// rgyal sras dang mtshungs sems dpa' rnam bcu drug

/btsun mo lta bu'i yum chen rnam pa bzhi// mchod mdzad lha mo brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba'i// gzhal med khang 'di bsrungs shing bskyong ba la// bag yod sgo bsrungs bzhi ni rang rang gi /phrin las sgrub la g.yel ba mdzad mi mnga'// khyab bdag rnam snang chen pos rigs rnam bzhi// thugs rgyud bskul nas rang rang phyogs kyi ni// rgyal ba'i sras bzhi dam tshig bskyed pa dang*// smin grol byed po'i bkra shis ma lus byon// de nas ngan song 'joms mdzad rgyud rgyal gyi// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam drug po'i// rtsa ba'i lha tshogs drug tshan lnga bzhugs pas// yul ljongs gang 'dir bde 'gro'i lam bzang mtshon// khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i sku gsung thugs// mi phyed rdo rje ngo bor rtag bzhugs pa// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don du yon tan dang*// phrin las ma lus stsol ba'i bkra shis spyon// sa skyong yab yum sras bcas dad pa'i lha// byams dang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug dang*// 'chi med phrin las stsol la mi lhod pa// mi pham 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dbang po// khams gsum las rgyal rdo rje rnam 'joms dang*// 'chi med dbang po bcom ldan tshe dpag med// 'chi bdag bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i sku// phrin las dbang phyug sgrol mdzad rnam gnyis bzhugs// 'chi med mkhyen brtse rang gi rgyud phyug cing*// mthu stobs dpung gis rgol ngan pham byas nas// rang srid skyong ba'i phrin las thams cad pa// gong nas gong mar spel ba'i bkra shis spyon// bsrung mdzad lha mo lnga dang gdugs dkar can// 'od zer 'gyed mdzad sku dang brtan g.yo'i dug /sel mdzad bcom ldan ma dang ri khrod kyi// lo ma gyon mdzad lha mo'i sku rnams bzhugs// pha rol rgol bas lan brgyar mi tshugs shing*// rims dang dug dang 'jigs chen brgyad rnams dang*// srid pa'i gzhung lugs skyong la gegs byed pa'i// gdon chen dbyings su zhi ba'i bkra shis spyon// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin grul bum gyi// 'khor tshogs bye bas bskor ba'i rgyal chen bzhi// dam pa'i chos dang de 'dzin 'dus pa'i sde// tshul bzhin skyong la g.yengs med 'di na bzhugs// sngon tshe ston pa'i spyan sngar bstan pa dang*// de 'dzin skye bo gang na 'khod gyur pa'i// phyi bzhin 'brangs nas bsrung zhing skyob bo zhes// dam bcas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bkra shis spyon// steng 'og phyogs dang phyogs bral mtha' dag gi

/mu med gzhung lugs gang der rang gnas su// lha dang drang srong grub pa'i skur sprul nas// phyogs chen rnam bcu skyong mdzad 'di na bzhugs// thugs che thabs mkhas thugs rgal dkyel mdzangs kyi// chos dang srid kyi gzhung chen de bzung nas// rang rang phyogs kyi bden pa bsrung mdzad pa'i// ngo mtshar bkra shis ma lus deng 'dir spyon// 'jig rten gsum rigs dbang mdzad bcom ldan ma// 'gugs mdzad 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar 'od can// 'jig rten dbang po'i sras chen tshogs kyi bdag /nor 'dzin lha mo dang bcas 'di na bzhugs// chos kyi sde chen gong nas gong spel zhing*// 'tshe med 'dod pa'i sde yang yid bzhin gyi// nor bu ji bzhin stsol la lhun grub pa// gnas 'dir rgyun mi chad pa'i bkra shis spyon// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes me chen po// 'bar mdzad drag po'i skur bstan mgon po'i zhabs// nam yang bstan mkhas srid pa gsum gyi bdag /'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang bcas 'di na bzhugs// mthu stobs nyin mor byed pa'i tsha zer gyis// mi bsrun mun pa'i bud shing za mdzad cing*// bkra shis bsil zer mang po'i mgon gang gis// rang srid utpal rgyas pa'i dge legs spyon// de ltar ngo mtshar mang po'i las stabs mkhan// gzhan sde gnon dang rang srid skyong ba dang*// thub bstan phan bder byed pa'i rim gro pa// 'jug pa rnam bcu'i byed po de ji bzhin// gang 'di'i legs mdzad dzanhu'i bu mo yis// gzhan yid dregs pa 'phrog mdzad rkang pa'i dug /sel mkhas lam gsum pa de ji lta bar// chos kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i don du bsngo// rang rang drung na brgya byin ji bzhin du// mngon rlom dregs pas rgyal ba mang mchis kyang*// sa chen skyong mkhas chos kyi bgyi ba la// 'gran byed tshangs chen gnyis pa gzhan yod min// de skad smra 'di sa skyong gi /'byor pa'i rgya mtshor ngal gsos pa// dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyi/

dpal ldan gser mdog can nas gnas so// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
